cfrp.title: Seismic response of CFRP-strengthened concrete piers
cfrp.intro: Comparison of a reinforced concrete pier in its unstrengthened (BASE) condition and with carbon-fibre confinement, under cyclic lateral loading.
cfrp.method: The project documentation describes calibration of a fibre-section model against a reference cyclic test (column C7), equivalent core confinement and comparison of force, stiffness, drift and energy in the BASE and CFRP conditions.
cfrp.result: Reported findings for the studied case: a calibration NRMSE of 7.928%, completion of 117/117 cyclic targets and a 12.725% increase in positive lateral force at +5% drift. Initial stiffness did not increase.
cfrp.caution: The data and analysis files needed to reproduce these findings have yet to be added. The indicators apply to this case; the figures are conceptual and do not show calculated response curves.

e030.title: Seismic verification with ETABS, Python and Mathcad Prime
e030.intro: A proposed controlled workflow to extract structural information, organize model data and produce documented verification calculations.
e030.method: The architecture separates read-only extraction from ETABS, normalization and validation in Python, calculation in Mathcad Prime and document production. Its defined scope includes checks of structural regularity, drift, seismic weight and design parameters.
e030.result: The architecture and functional scope are defined. The calculation engine and final report format remain in development.
e030.caution: The prototype has not been validated for code-compliance checks. Its implemented edition and adaptation to E.030 2026 remain unconfirmed; current references do not validate the calculation engine.

lisp.title: AutoLISP routines for structural detailing
lisp.intro: Automated structural drafting based on reviewed parameters, reinforcement details and consistent drawing conventions.
lisp.method: The described routines cover beams, columns, structural walls, stairs, stirrups, longitudinal reinforcement and dimensions. A proposed next step would use Python to validate parameter tables and AutoLISP to generate geometry, retaining identifiers, units and revisions. This integration has not yet been implemented.
lisp.result: The documentation organises command families for structural members. The .lsp source, reproducible examples and AutoCAD screenshots have yet to be published.
lisp.caution: No independent validation of the routines is published. Images are conceptual diagrams, not AutoCAD screenshots or construction drawings.

columnas.title: Response of strengthened columns in buildings up to 12 storeys
columnas.intro: A proposed study comparing preventive strengthening alternatives and their effects on seismic response indicators.
columnas.method: The proposal defines a manageable set of reinforced concrete column models and demand scenarios, comparing local strengthening options such as CFRP and jacketing. Controlled parameters would be used to explain trends in strength, deformation capacity and ductility.
columnas.result: The study is at the scope-definition stage, with no calculated findings yet.
columnas.caution: Research proposal; it does not include validated assessments of existing buildings.
